instruction_translation: Proceed with the five-step plan: attribute facing/concrete/rebar rendering; pilot and expand grouped rendering; optimize blocker collection/comparison if still material; optimize damaged-column updates; validate intact, firing, settled debris and F6 states.
approved_scope: Measure shadows and visibility for facing, concrete and rebar in identical views.
Reduce separate render components through shared groups of identical geometry; first validate a small neighboring group, then expand to all 16 LobbyColumns01 columns.
Measure residual blocker collection and comparison; introduce supported registration/invalidation only if justified, preserving projectile history checks.
Restrict damaged-column work to moving parts and necessary support checks; safely wake settled fragments on relevant events.
Compare mean frame time and long-frame percentiles across intact, multi-column firing, settled debris and F6 states with identical settings/views.
constraints: Preserve materials, visual detail, shadows, collision, destruction fidelity and first-hit behavior.
Preserve the central demo, unrelated experiments, architecture and owner edits.
No asset reduction, reduced fragment limits, or gameplay simplification is authorized.
The earlier Perf01 direct/self-review waiver covers its two changes only; normal execution and review policies apply here.
